general.label: Emergency (police, fire, road safety and other responders)

source.title: COVID-19: NCC's 112 National Emergency Number Offers Succour to Nigerians | NCC

notes: 112 is the toll-free National Emergency Number run by the Nigerian Communications Commission; calls are handled by Emergency Communication Centres and passed to first responders such as the Police, Fire Service and Federal Road Safety Corps. Source: https://ncc.gov.ng/media-centre/press-releases/covid-19-nccs-112-national-emergency-number-offers-succour-nigerians, retrieved 2026-09-26.

The National Economic Council approved 112 as the National Emergency Number at all levels (30 April 2026). Source: https://statehouse.gov.ng/nec-moves-to-strengthen-national-emergency-response-okays-112-as-lifeline/ (State House, Abuja), retrieved 2026-09-26.

Emergency Communication Centres answering 112 have been rolled out state by state: 17 states and the FCT as of April 2020, with expansion to other states ongoing. Source: https://ncc.gov.ng/media-centre/press-releases/covid-19-nccs-112-national-emergency-number-offers-succour-nigerians (NCC, April 2020), retrieved 2026-09-26.
